summary:
Earth Jukebox is an interactive web application that transforms NASA Earth observation data into sound, making our planet’s complex environmental changes more accessible, engaging, and understandable. Through an interactive 3D globe, users can explore different countries and locations, discover scientific data, and experience environmental patterns through sonification.

Our project converts climate data, including temperature variations and ocean conditions, into musical patterns, allowing users to hear changes that are traditionally presented through graphs and visualizations. By combining interactive exploration, scientific visualization, and audio, Earth Jukebox creates a multisensory experience that encourages curiosity and environmental awareness.

Earth Jukebox addresses the NASA Space Apps challenge by providing an innovative way to experience Earth science beyond visual interpretation, particularly for individuals with visual impairments. Our goal is to make scientific data accessible to everyone, regardless of their background or abilities, while inspiring a deeper understanding of our changing planet.

Ultimately, Earth Jukebox allows users not only to see the Earth but also to hear its story.
details:
Earth Jukebox is an interactive web application that transforms NASA Earth observation data into sound through data sonification. Users can explore an interactive 3D globe, select geographical locations, and discover environmental patterns through visual and auditory experiences. The application translates numerical environmental data into different sound characteristics, such as pitch and frequency, allowing users to hear variations in Earth's environmental conditions.

The project aims to make Earth science more accessible, engaging, and inclusive, particularly for individuals with visual impairments. By combining scientific data with music and interactive technology, Earth Jukebox provides an alternative to traditional graphs and visualizations. It encourages environmental awareness, supports scientific education, and helps users develop a deeper understanding of our changing planet.

Our team developed the application using Bolt, web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, NASA Earth observation resources, and data sonification techniques. The platform is designed to be accessible directly through a web browser without requiring specialized hardware or software installation.

The creativity of our project lies in combining science, music, technology, and accessibility into a single immersive experience. Instead of simply displaying environmental statistics, Earth Jukebox allows users to experience scientific information through sound, creating a more engaging and memorable connection with our planet.

Throughout development, our team considered accessibility, scientific accuracy, user experience, educational value, and technical feasibility. We prioritized creating an intuitive interface that makes complex scientific information easier to understand while ensuring that the platform has the potential to incorporate additional NASA datasets and sonification features in the future.

Our ultimate goal is to demonstrate that scientific information can be experienced beyond sight, making Earth science more inclusive and inspiring people to explore, understand, and appreciate our planet through the power of sound.
